evidence_required: A list of the missing evidence, with the command or privilege needed for each.

marking.criterion: States what can be concluded from unprivileged sources (inventory, PCIe width via sysfs, MTU and speeds; idle GPU downshift is benign)
States what cannot be concluded (kernel-log health AER/EDAC/Xid/MCE, storage latency and per-CPU behaviour, PCIe speed under load, process NUMA placement)
Next collection steps with the command or privilege for each (sysstat, root or adm/systemd-journal group, collect under load with --pid)

title: What "healthy (check gaps)" means
